name: Nicoll Highway
summary: CCL city-fringe stop by the Kallang Basin — condo-led living with park connector access, stadium adjacency, and sharper premiums than deeper heartland east.
body: Nicoll Highway suits renters who want Circle Line proximity to the city fringe and basin park connectors without committing to River Valley prices. Housing skews condo with limited HDB; weekend sports and event spillover from the Kallang belt show up in traffic. Expats shortlist it for CCL desk hops and outdoor volume; accept thinner hawker density than Old Airport Road and higher condo MCST scrutiny on visitor parking. Compare with Mountbatten for more food-belt texture, Aljunied for NEL heartland value, and Stadium/Kallang catchments when you want to live even closer to ActiveSG infrastructure.
